### Two implementation notes worth your attention

1. **`main()` catches `SystemExit` from `parse_args`** and returns its status, so `main(argv)` always returns an int (`--help` → 0, usage error → 1). T038's review wording anticipated `sqlite3.Error`/`OSError` as the only `except` clauses; this second one converts argparse's exit into an explicit error result rather than swallowing anything — the diagnostic has already been written — which Principle II permits. 2. **`matches_tag` guards the empty tag**: implemented as `bool(stored_tags) and tag in stored_tags.split(",")` rather than the bare membership test in T024, because `"".split(",") == [""]` would otherwise make `--tag ""` match every untagged bookmark — a wrong answer rather than a loud failure. An empty tag can never be stored, so it now correctly matches nothing.

Also worth knowing: per T007 the store-error handler wraps the whole command, so a `BrokenPipeError` from e.g. `list | head` is reported as "cannot use the bookmark store …" with the underlying error.
